optPipNote.message:
Picture-in-Picture (Beta): the right-click menu also has an "Open in Picture-in-Picture (Beta)" entry.
• Right-click menu always opens directly (the right-click is itself a page user gesture).
• Extension button needs a recent click on the page to open directly; a cold page (just loaded, no interaction) first shows a "Click to start" overlay — clicking it starts PiP. This is Chrome's security restriction on PiP and cannot be bypassed.
• SPA sites (Google, Gmail, etc.) render most content via JS; once moved to PiP, CSP security restrictions block execution, so they may appear blank or incomplete — static article pages (Wikipedia, MDN) work best.
